name: django-extensions-32ddfb04-blind30-ots
instr:
# A Django helper toolkit misbehaving from the interactive shell to the command line, without a test suite

A toolkit of add-ons for a Python web framework — the sort of thing you lean on at an interactive prompt, in page templates, when storing rows and when running chores from a terminal — is wrong in a great many small ways at once. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Nothing in my own project changed, and none of what follows is anything I asked for; it is simply what I saw, set out by what I was doing at the time.

Working at the enhanced interactive prompt with SQL printing switched on, what gets echoed is not the statement that ran: the statement text and its parameters have swapped places, so the expected SELECT against the user table never shows up. Asking as well for that printed SQL to be cut to a given number of characters is not honoured either — with a cut-off of four the text is not shortened to four, and asking for no cut-off does not give the whole statement back. When two apps define a model of the same name and the setting that decides how such clashes are aliased is the one that qualifies them by their full dotted path, the automatic pulling-in of models blows up with a type error instead of offering the qualified names alongside the plain ones.
